steps.title: Свести сравнение и принять решение о commit

checks.command: Review measured baseline/candidate results, the user's visual confirmation and the explicit request to publish a GitHub release.
checks.output: Release decision accepted. The old 0.4.0 first synthesis was reported unacceptably slow; the candidate replaces per-launch full hashing with a 2-3 ms receipt check, prewarms in about 3.5 s, reuses the worker in 0 ms, exposes preparation progress, and unloads it after about 15 minutes. Fresh live-microphone dictation remains disclosed as NOT_RUN.
